test_title: PYST 137: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 30 Jan, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are show having symbols - $, ∆, ¥, Ω, O and *. Find the symbol on the face opposite the face showing 'O'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3515808f11ff05f9d7a84a64fee1238cb4fcf27a54652c6f07db07dfc5cf6b2a.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be40e6efa039d8343f2315b3634153df0c15c185260b9b700bb8c5b0804d1107.png]
solution:
As $ and [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b742523f99d00cc9a3344186779f499ea27c84b7339185849e4719b9a7de2711.png] are the common faces on both the dice, the remaining faces are opposite to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3515808f11ff05f9d7a84a64fee1238cb4fcf27a54652c6f07db07dfc5cf6b2a.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be40e6efa039d8343f2315b3634153df0c15c185260b9b700bb8c5b0804d1107.png] 

Therefore, '*' symbol is on the face opposite the face showing 'O'.

Hence, ‘*****’ is the correct answer.
